description: This file implements TCP connection handling and shell commands for network debugging in Zephyr OS, including connection setup, data transmission, reception, and closure, with support for IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: tcp_connected
methods.description: Callback invoked upon TCP connection attempt completion, reports success or failure.

methods.name: get_my_ipv6_addr
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv6 source address for a network interface.

methods.name: get_my_ipv4_addr
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv4 source address for a network interface.

methods.name: print_connect_info
methods.description: Prints connection source and destination addresses based on protocol family.

methods.name: tcp_connect
methods.description: Establishes a TCP connection to a specified host and port, handling IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: tcp_sent_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when a message has been sent over TCP.

methods.name: tcp_recv_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when data is received over TCP or connection is closed.

methods.name: cmd_net_tcp_connect
methods.description: Shell command to initiate TCP connection.

methods.name: cmd_net_tcp_send
methods.description: Shell command to send data over TCP.

methods.name: cmd_net_tcp_recv
methods.description: Shell command to receive data over TCP.

methods.name: cmd_net_tcp_close
methods.description: Shell command to close TCP connection.

methods.name: cmd_net_tcp
methods.description: Stub command for TCP shell subcommands.
